answer: I did not run the job. Garnet has only 20 qubits, so it cannot run a 30-qubit GHZ circuit. The docs list Garnet as Crystal 20. I checked this with a live backend query, which costs no credits. Both garnet and garnet:mock reported num_qubits = 20. I submitted no jobs and spent no credits. Two options would work. The first option is a GHZ circuit of up to 20 qubits on garnet. The second option is a 30-qubit GHZ on emerald, which has 54 qubits and costs about 0.75 credits per second. Either option needs a new request.
